Title: Containers and delivery basics
Why: Containers and automated pipelines are the base of modern operations.

Steps.Text: Install Docker and run, then build, your first container.
Write a Dockerfile for a small app and read about layer caching.
Create a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and tests on every push.

Title: Running services for real
Why: Compose, reverse proxies and TLS cover most small-to-medium production setups.

Steps.Text: Describe an app and its database with Docker Compose.
Put nginx or Caddy in front with automatic HTTPS.
Add metrics with Prometheus and a Grafana dashboard.

Title: Kubernetes and infrastructure as code
Why: Cluster operations and reproducible infrastructure at scale.

Steps.Text: Run a local cluster and deploy an app with a Deployment and Service.
Describe cloud resources with OpenTofu or Terraform.
Define SLOs for a service and alert on error-budget burn.
